newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London end lower on U.S data.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London end lower on U.S data.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London edged lower on Friday as the market digested key U.S. payrolls data while buyers held back to see the effect on Wall Street, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended the day 15.56 points, or 0.13 percent lower at 12,189.03 in scant trade.
"Originally people thought the figures were positive so we went better and then on closer scrutiny they obviously decided they were not so we came off," one trader said.

U.S. data released on Friday showed March non-farm payrolls rose by a seasonally-adjusted 175,000 which was slightly below expectations. But analysts said the $0.05 increase in hourly earnings could trigger a potential U.S. credit tightening in the near-term.
In Hong Kong the Hang Seng Index closed 149.92 points, or 1.24 percent higher at 12,204.59.
